strategy_description: Go long SPY when bullish, short SPY when bearish.

selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the committed coarse monthly grid L{0,1,2,3,6} (674 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.6804). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.
